faq_caffeinate_question: Does caffeinate or Amphetamine not do this already?
faq_caffeinate_answer: They keep your Mac awake until a set time or until you stop them. They do not know when an agent works. Agent Caffeine does, also with the lid closed on battery, and lets your Mac sleep after.
faq_battery_question: Does it drain my battery when nothing runs?
faq_battery_answer: No. When no agent works, your Mac sleeps as usual. On battery, Agent Caffeine also stops at {floor}%.
faq_admin_answer: Only to stay awake with the lid closed on battery. You allow a small helper once in System Settings. Everything else works without it.
faq_detection_question: How does it know that an agent is working?

faq_waiting_question: What happens when an agent waits for my answer?
faq_waiting_answer: Your Mac stays awake for 5 minutes, so you can answer. After that it can sleep.
faq_phone_question: Can I reach my agent from my phone while the lid is closed?
faq_phone_answer: Yes. Choose Stay reachable, and your Mac stays awake for 1, 2 or 4 hours. On battery with the lid closed it needs the helper. A message cannot wake a sleeping Mac.
faq_script_question: Can it keep my Mac awake for a script or a render?
faq_script_answer: Yes. Put agent-caffeine hold -- in front of the command. Your Mac stays awake while the command runs, and can sleep when it ends.
faq_mcp_question: Does it have an MCP server?
faq_mcp_answer: Yes. The command agent-caffeine mcp gives an agent three tools: hold_awake, release and status. A hold ends when the session of the agent ends.
